name: AABB Representation (Min/Max)
definition: An Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) represented by storing the minimum and maximum coordinate values for each of the three axes (x, y, z). This treats the AABB as the intersection of three 'slabs', where a slab is an infinite region bounded by two parallel 3D planes.
summary: AABB Representation (Min/Max) defines a bounding box using six coordinate values, enabling trivial component-wise merging unlike centroid-based methods.
